```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)
library(ggrepel)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
rna <- read_csv("rnaCibersort.csv")
rna <- rna[, 2:ncol(rna)]
rna
```

```{r}
prot <- read_csv("protCibersort.csv")
prot <- prot[, 2:ncol(prot)]
prot
```

```{r}
df <- full_join(rna, prot, by = c("SampleID" = "rnaSample"))
```
```{r}
dfFilt <- df[df$Flag.x == "Suspicious" | df$Flag.y == "Suspicious", ]
dfFilt
```
```{r}
dim(dfFilt)
dfFilt1 <- dfFilt[!apply(is.na(dfFilt), 1, all), ]
dim(dfFilt1)
```

```{r}
write.csv(dfFilt, "cibersortSuspicious.csv")
write.csv(dfFilt1, "cibersortSuspiciousFiltered.csv")
```

```{r}
dfPlot <- dfFilt1 %>%
  mutate(
    flag_combined = case_when(
      Flag.x == "Suspicious" & Flag.y == "Suspicious" ~ "Both Suspicious",
      Flag.x == "Suspicious" & Flag.y == "OK"         ~ "Only x Suspicious",
      Flag.x == "OK" & Flag.y == "Suspicious"         ~ "Only y Suspicious",
      Flag.x == "OK" & Flag.y == "OK"                 ~ "Both OK",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    ),
    sample_label = paste(SampleID, SampleID.y, sep = " / ")
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(dfPlot, aes(x = Total_Bcells.x, y = Total_Bcells.y)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = flag_combined), size = 3) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sample_label),
    hjust = -0.1,
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Both OK" = "forestgreen",
      "Only x Suspicious" = "orange",
      "Only y Suspicious" = "blue",
      "Both Suspicious" = "red",
      "Unknown" = "grey"
    )
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~"B cells") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Total B cells (Transcriptomics)",
    y = "Total B cells (Proteomics)",
    color = "Flag combination"
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(dfPlot, aes(x = Total_Tcells.x, y = Total_Tcells.y)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = flag_combined), size = 3) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sample_label),
    hjust = -0.1,
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Both OK" = "forestgreen",
      "Only x Suspicious" = "orange",
      "Only y Suspicious" = "blue",
      "Both Suspicious" = "red",
      "Unknown" = "grey"
    )
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~"T cells") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Total T cells (Trancriptomics)",
    y = "Total T cells (Proteomics)",
    color = "Flag combination"
  )
```
